task: Implement the nightly job that rolls up raw Helios usage events into billable aggregates.

rubric.criterion: The rollup is idempotent and re-runnable using a per-tenant monotonic watermark, not a sum-from-scratch each run.
Late usage events (arriving up to ~72h late) are handled by reopening/re-aggregating the affected period rather than being dropped.
No raw PII or secret values are written to logs.
